_source: Hand-kept; wins over models.dev. Keys are provider/model as our config names them. Prices per million tokens, per audio second or per lookup.

vertex/text-embedding-004._source: Not on models.dev. LiteLLM's vertex_ai text-embedding-004 price, USD 0.10 per million input tokens.

openai-compatible/glm-5.3._source: Scaleway Generative APIs, fr-par realtime, read 2026-11-03: input EUR 0.0018 and output EUR 0.0055 per 1000 tokens. https://www.scaleway.com/en/pricing/model-as-a-service/ (public catalog: https://api.scaleway.com/product-catalog/v2alpha1/public-catalog/products?product_types=generative_apis)

openai-compatible/qwen3-embedding-8b._source: Scaleway Generative APIs, fr-par realtime, read 2026-11-03: input EUR 0.0001 per 1000 tokens. https://www.scaleway.com/en/pricing/model-as-a-service/ (public catalog: https://api.scaleway.com/product-catalog/v2alpha1/public-catalog/products?product_types=generative_apis)

openai-compatible/whisper-large-v3._source: Scaleway Generative APIs, fr-par realtime, read 2026-11-03: input audio EUR 0.003 per 60 seconds. https://www.scaleway.com/en/pricing/model-as-a-service/ (public catalog: https://api.scaleway.com/product-catalog/v2alpha1/public-catalog/products?product_types=generative_apis)

searchQuery._source: Vertex AI grounding with Google Search list price, USD 14 per 1000 queries; Google's free monthly lookups are project-wide, so every lookup is charged.
